turnaround_reason: Forward Air fell ~70% after its contested, debt-laden 2024 acquisition of Omni Logistics, which triggered a shareholder revolt and left the balance sheet at ~5.5x net leverage. It is now basing (+9.7% on the day of the dossier, +17% over 30d) as a board-led strategic review pivots from a full-company sale to asset divestitures aimed at deleveraging.
bullish_points: Record operating quarter: Q2 2026 revenue $673M (all-time high) with consolidated EBITDA $93M, the best in 2.5 years and margin up a full point across all segments
Hard catalyst: Intermodal sale on track to close by end of 2026, plus legacy Omni unit sales, with proceeds earmarked to pay down the $1.68B net debt
Deep-value / special-situation setup: EV/EBITDA ~9.1 vs a beaten-down ~7-8x ground-freight sector, on a name that has already sold off 70%
Activist and sponsor presence: Clearlake Capital holds ~13.8% and Ancora has publicly pushed for a value-maximizing sale — pressure that keeps the board action-oriented
Massive Q2 EPS surprise ($1.53 vs -$0.15 est) shows operating leverage as the integration matures
bearish_points: Balance sheet is the whole story: net debt ~5.5x EBITDA, negative book equity (P/B -5.2), and the thesis is entirely dependent on executing asset sales at good prices
No full-company buyer emerged from the strategic review — a negative signal about how the market values the whole
Only 2 analysts cover it and Q2 EPS beat may include non-recurring items; forward P/E ~41.6 shows earnings are still thin
Freight cycle is soft and sector multiples are compressing (transport EV/EBITDA fell from ~11x to ~8x into Q2 2026)
Litigation overhang from the no-vote Omni structure; execution risk on retaining Intermodal customer revenue post-sale
catalyst: Announcement/close of the Intermodal divestiture and use of proceeds to deleverage; conclusion of the strategic review
catalyst_timing: Intermodal sale expected to close by end of 2026; next earnings 2026-11-04
suggested_trade: Small speculative spot position sized as a binary special-situation bet; scale only on a signed Intermodal sale at a credible multiple. See data/research/FWRD.md
key_risk: Intermodal/Omni asset sales close at disappointing prices (or slip), leaving net leverage stuck above 5x into a soft freight cycle and forcing dilutive equity or covenant trouble
would_skip_if: The Intermodal sale is pulled or repriced sharply lower, leverage covenants tighten, or the company signals an equity raise
